import json, itertools
w=json.loads(context)
qs={s:[] for s in w['skus']}
for q in w['quotes']:
 d=w['skus'][q['sku']]
 if q['quality']=='approved' and d['demand']<=q['units']<=d['demand']+2 and q['arrival']<=d['deadline']:
  qs[q['sku']].append(q)
vendors={v['id']:v for v in w['vendors']}
best=None
for combo in itertools.product(*(qs[s] for s in w['skus'])):
 by={v:[] for v in vendors}
 for q in combo: by[q['vendor']].append(q)
 if sum(bool(a) for a in by.values())<3: continue
 if any(q['needs_same_vendor_sku'] and next(x for x in combo if x['sku']==q['needs_same_vendor_sku'])['vendor']!=q['vendor'] for q in combo): continue
 if sum(q['carbon'] for q in combo)>w['carbon_cap']: continue
 total=0; ok=True
 for vid,items in by.items():
  if not items: continue
  v=vendors[vid]; units=sum(q['units'] for q in items)
  if units>v['unit_cap']: ok=False; break
  gross=sum(q['units']*q['unit_cents'] for q in items)
  merch=(gross*(10000-v['tier_bps'])+5000)//10000 if units>=v['tier_units'] else gross
  cost=merch+(0 if gross>=v['free_shipping_gross'] else v['shipping_cents'])
  if len({q['sku'] for q in items})>=2 and merch>=v['rebate_merchandise_min']: cost-=v['rebate_cents']
  total+=cost
 if ok and (best is None or total<best): best=total
print(FINAL(str(best)))
